apple_underdogs_kinetic.name: Apple 'The Underdogs' Kinetic Ensemble
apple_underdogs_kinetic.best_for: Collaborative SaaS, hardware ecosystems, team productivity, creative workflows
apple_underdogs_kinetic.pacing: Fast, rhythmic, dialogue-driven, comedic friction, naturalistic audio

narrative_arc.01_the_crisis: High-stakes deadline or logistical mishap lands unexpectedly (0-6s)
narrative_arc.02_the_huddle: Team scrambling, rapid overlapping dialogue, desks covered in papers and coffee (6-14s)
narrative_arc.03_the_flow: Products deployed effortlessly; AirDrop, handoff, seamless real-time syncing (14-22s)
narrative_arc.04_the_triumph: Pitch delivered, crisis averted, grounded humorous celebration (22-28s)
narrative_arc.05_clean_tag: Minimalist typography and subtle product sound signature (28-30s)

apple_underdogs_kinetic.cinematography: Arri Alexa Rec.709, 35mm handheld with natural organic sway, warm commercial daylight, crisp practical foley.

perplexity_friction_contrast.name: Perplexity Radical Friction-to-Clarity Contrast
perplexity_friction_contrast.inspiration: Perplexity Super Bowl & 'Why Search When You Can Know' campaigns
perplexity_friction_contrast.best_for: AI search, knowledge intelligence, decision engines, research acceleration
perplexity_friction_contrast.pacing: High-contrast split, chaotic sensory overload transitioning to serene cognitive clarity

narrative_arc.01_the_cacophony: Drowning in 20 open tabs, flashing cookie banners, paywalls, scrolling fatigue (0-8s)
narrative_arc.02_the_interrupt: Protagonist stops typing, closes eyes in exhaustion; silence drops (8-12s)
narrative_arc.03_the_single_prompt: A clean, natural question is asked; interface purges all visual garbage (12-18s)
narrative_arc.04_the_breakthrough: Sourced, synthesized truth appears instantly; protagonist exhales with clarity (18-26s)
narrative_arc.05_provocative_cta: Provocative tagline: 'Why search when you can know?' (26-30s)

perplexity_friction_contrast.cinematography: High-contrast lighting, 50mm Zeiss prime, starting with cold fluorescent grading and transitioning to warm 5000K daylight, deep bass drop on the pivot.

openai_poetic_manifesto.name: OpenAI Poetic Awe & Creative Liberation
openai_poetic_manifesto.inspiration: OpenAI Sora launch films, ChatGPT brand anthems
openai_poetic_manifesto.best_for: Foundation models, breakthrough creative tools, visionary tech platforms
openai_poetic_manifesto.pacing: Contemplative, expansive, reverent, philosophical voiceover, large-format visual scale

narrative_arc.01_the_spark: Intimate micro-shot of a creator or scientist lost in contemplation (0-10s)
narrative_arc.02_the_metaphor: Mental concepts ripple physically through the real world via photorealistic magic realism (10-25s)
narrative_arc.03_the_human_spectrum: Global montage across craft, medicine, music, space exploration, and family moments (25-45s)
narrative_arc.04_the_settle: Grounded human smile of pure connection, unforced wonder (45-56s)

openai_poetic_manifesto.cinematography: Large-format 65mm sensor look, 35mm Anamorphic 2.39:1 widescreen, golden hour and twilight illumination, rich filmic grain.

uber_relatable_absurdity.name: Uber Eats Relatable Absurdity & Honest Truth
uber_relatable_absurdity.inspiration: 'Get Almost, Almost Anything' campaign by Special US/Australia
uber_relatable_absurdity.best_for: On-demand delivery, consumer marketplaces, retail platforms, everyday lifestyle apps
uber_relatable_absurdity.pacing: Deadpan comedic timing, visual misdirection, celebrity or relatable actor charm

narrative_arc.01_the_impossible_order: Character misinterprets a common term literally (orders a 'Medieval Knight' or 'A Second Chance') (0-6s)
narrative_arc.02_the_cinematic_escalation: The impossible delivery arrives, causing hilarious cinematic chaos (6-16s)
narrative_arc.03_the_reality_reset: Abrupt cut back to normal everyday reality; character is actually opening groceries or a meal (16-24s)

uber_relatable_absurdity.cinematography: Vibrant 35mm commercial lighting, punchy medium shots, snappy cuts, dry acoustic comedic dialogue.

keilhq_human_life_first.name: KeilHQ 'Work Ends. Life Continues.' Anti-Grind Paradigm
keilhq_human_life_first.best_for: Modern enterprise software, AI workflow automation, executive productivity tools
keilhq_human_life_first.pacing: Gentle, understated, candid lifestyle realism, emotional maturity

narrative_arc.01_the_mental_overhead: The subtle weight of unfinished work lingering in a beautiful home (0-8s)
narrative_arc.02_the_silent_resolution: The system quietly finishes the complex pipeline without frantic user effort (8-16s)
narrative_arc.03_the_closure: The laptop closes firmly. The desk is physically left behind (16-24s)
narrative_arc.04_the_life_continuation: Character turns attention fully to child, partner, or dinner table (24-28s)
narrative_arc.05_quiet_landing: 'Your life shouldn't have to feel like work. KeilHQ.' (28-30s)

keilhq_human_life_first.cinematography: Kodak Portra 400 warmth, 35mm documentary prime, soft natural window light, domestic foley and subtle felt piano.
